quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of LWF, we apply our method to domain-specific question-answering tasks.

We apply LWF to domain-specific question-answering tasks... We also apply LWF to machine translation tasks, selecting four language datasets (German, French, Turkish, Chinese) and evaluate with BLEU and BERTScore-F1.
In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Learning With Forgetting (LWF), to achieve graceful forgetting in generative language models.
outputs: generated answers for QA and translated sentences for MT
The model generates answers to questions and translates text between languages.

quote: wellestablished evaluation metrics (i.e., accuracy)... BLEU and BERTScore-F1 are used as evaluation metrics.
Accuracy is used for QA evaluation; BLEU and BERTScore-F1 are used for machine translation; we also compute cosine similarity with SimCSE and Type Token Ratio.

We selected four language datasets-German (DE), French (FR), Turkish (TR), and Chinese (ZH)-from the WMT  corpus to evaluate the model's ability to translate from English into those languages. BLEU  and BERTScore-F1  are used as evaluation metrics.
